verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that premium processing is bundled into Founder Law's all-inclusive packages. Nothing in the pack explains Form I-907 mechanics: which classifications qualify, what the government fee is, or what premium processing does and does not speed up. Bundling the fee is an adjacent pricing feature, not the explanatory capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider explains premium processing (Form I-907) mechanics — which classifications qualify, what it costs, and what it does and does not speed up
